questions.explain: Betaflight is firmware for manual flying: minimum latency and a tunable response.

questions.q: What do you do right after the first flash of an FC?
questions.explain: A backup before changes is the point to return to. The props, by the way, should already be off.

questions.q: Where is the configuration stored in Betaflight?
options: In a file on the SD card
questions.explain: The configuration lives on the board and is exported with the diff all / dump command.

questions.q: How does diff all differ from dump?
options: diff does not include profiles and rate profiles
diff is only the differences from the defaults
questions.explain: diff all is readable and can be carried between versions deliberately; dump drags all the defaults along as explicit values.

questions.q: What is a target when flashing?
options: The video transmitter channel for the flight
questions.explain: The target describes the board: processor, gyro, pins. The wrong target means NOGYRO and ports that do not work.

questions.q: What does the BUILD KEY in the status output show?
options: A hash of the diff all file for verification
questions.explain: With it Cloud Build reproduces the same build; it is not in diff all — save the status output.

questions.q: The LOAD flag among the arming flags:
options: diff was not loaded after flashing
questions.explain: CPU overload: pid_process_denom = 2 or disable features; tasks shows the heavy tasks.

questions.q: What does the gyro task do in Betaflight?
options: Reads the gyro and filters the signal
questions.explain: The gyro task is reading the gyro (up to 8 kHz) and the filters; the PID task is calculating the output.
